- **E-Reader** (7-inch, Wi-Fi, 8GB) - $244.02
- **Jigsaw Puzzle** (2000 pieces, fantasy) - $52.03
- **T-Shirt** (blue, M, cotton) - $50.88

The refund will be issued to the original payment method, which is your PayPal account.

Please confirm if everything is correct, and I'll proceed with the return request.
